question: Will the S&P 500 reach 7,000 before January 1, 2027?

model.prompt_context:
Resolution criteria:
- "Yes": Wins if the S&P 500 index (SPX) records an intraday high or official daily closing value of 7,000 or above on any regular trading session between the market's open and its settlement time (i.e., before January 1, 2027, UTC).
- "No": Wins if the S&P 500 index (SPX) does not reach an intraday high or official daily closing value of 7,000 or above on any regular trading session before January 1, 2027, UTC.
